historical_commentary.text: 4D View has been discontinued as a standalone product, making the specific style-sheet commands described here obsolete for current development; the general design pattern of saving and reapplying user formatting preferences remains a useful, still-applicable UX idea realized differently in current 4D form objects or web-based UIs.
related_updates: 4D View has been discontinued; current 4D form objects and web-based UI components provide different mechanisms for reusable styling/formatting
